responsibility: This subtarget configuration header defines the default command-line and multilib policy for NEC VR-series processors. It makes a VR4130 workaround architecture the default, forces or infers matching -march settings for the VR4120/VR4130 erratum-fix options, derives floating-point and EABI/long-size defaults, cleans up redundant gp-width options, and then applies the shared MIPS driver rules, so its role is to steer driver option normalization and multilib selection for VR embedded targets.
